description: Erection of a single storey rear extension and enlargement of the existing basement with one front and one rear lightwell, removal of two front roof lights, matching re-tiling of roof voids and installation of two front roof lights and installation of four rear roof lights to the house.
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall begin not later than three years from the date of this decision.

Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and specifications:  200 (Rev B), 201 (Rev A), 210 (Rev A), 211 (Rev A), 220 (Rev A) Received:  19 April 2024 and 001, 002, 100, 101, 110, 111, 120 Received:  01 March 2024.  

Reason: In order to ensure the development is carried out in accordance with the planning permission.

Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the development hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building, unless otherwise shown on the approved plans.Reason: In order to safeguard the appearance of the area.
Condition : 4 - The basement hereby permitted shall at no time be used or occupied as a separate dwelling independent of the main house and shall not be used as sleeping accommodation.
Condition : 5 - The extensions hereby permitted shall be built in line with flood management measures as shown in the submitted and hereby approved Flood Risk Assessment.

Condition : 6 - No development shall be carried out until such time as the person carrying out the work is a member of the Considerate Constructors Scheme and its code of practice, and the details of the membership and contact details are clearly displayed on the site so that they can be easily read by members of the public. Reason: In order to protect the living conditions of neighbouring residents in accordance with Local Plan Policies EQ4 (Air Quality), EQ5 (Noise) and EC2 (Developing a Sustainable Local Transport Network).
